signature_keyword: 차량 중심 시각화와 정밀한 모노크롬 터치스크린 UI
hero_html:
TESLA 9:41 72%
18분 12 km · 도착 10:02
P Model 3 주차됨 · 347 km
20.5°↟♨☎♫21.0°

sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Tesla
  • 한 줄 정체성: 전기차 + 에너지의 미래 — 자동차를 소프트웨어처럼 다루는 회사
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "Accelerating sustainable energy — bold simplicity, futuristic minimalism"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 넓은 지도와 차량 3D 시각화를 결합한 센터 터치스크린 + 하단 고정 제어 도크
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 미래적, 미니멀, 프리미엄
  • 무드 설명: 주간에는 밝은 지도와 검은 정보 위계, 야간에는 깊은 검정과 밝은 차량 시각화가 중심이다. 장식적 chrome을 줄이고 주행·충전·공조 상태를 넓은 화면에 직접 배치한다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 + 브루털리즘 (sharp ramp)
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Sharp (0~2px)
  • 평면성: Flat

sections.④:
• 폰트 페어링:
    • 영문: Gotham (Tesla 라이선스) — 폴백 "Helvetica Neue", -apple-system
    • 한글: Pretendard (OFL) / Apple SD Gothic Neo
  • 위계:
    • Display: 56px / 500 / 1.05 / -0.015em
    • H1 (워드마크): 28px / 500 / 1.2 / 0.6em (uppercase, ultra wide spacing)
    • H2: 32px / 500 / 1.2 / -0.01em
    • H3: 17px / 600 / 1.3 / 0
    • Body Large: 15px / 500 / 1.5 / 0
    • Body: 13px / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Caption: 11px / 600 / 1.27 / 0.06em (uppercase)
sections.⑦:
--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
--shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
--shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
--shadow-xl: 0 16px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);
sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 600 12px/1 Gotham,'Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: var(--radius-none); padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out), transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.btn-primary { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg-base); }
.btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #FFFFFF; }
.btn:hover { filter: contrast(.86); }
.btn:active { transform: scale(.98); }
.btn:disabled { color: var(--text-disabled); border-color: var(--border-default); background: var(--bg-subtle); cursor: not-allowed; }
.btn.is-loading { color: transparent; position: relative; }

Input

.input { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-none); padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit; }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--border-focus); }
.input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-error-fg); }
.input:disabled { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-disabled); }

Card

.card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-none); padding: 24px; }
.card-emphasis { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.card-outlined { background: transparent; }
.product { padding: 0; }
.product .img { aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#E5E5E5,#888); }
.product h3 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 14px 0 4px; text-align: center; }
.product .desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); text-align: center; }

Badge

.tag { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tag-solid { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg-base); }
.tag-subtle { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid var(--text-primary); color: var(--text-primary); background: transparent; }

Navigation (시그니처: 워드마크가 가운데 letter-spacing 큼)

.topnav { padding: 18px 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; }
.topnav .brand { font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.6em; color: var(--text-primary); }
.topnav nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
.topnav nav a { color: var(--text-primary); }
sections.⑪: 1. TESLA 워드마크의 letter-spacing(0.6em)을 변경 금지 2. 라운드(>4px) 적용 금지 — 0px sharp 시그니처 3. 채도 높은 컬러 분산 사용 금지 — 모노 + 차량 사진의 색만 4. 마케팅 페이지에 그라데이션 배경 금지 — 차량 자체의 그라데이션이 시그니처 5. 차량 사진을 작은 카드 안에 가두지 말 것 — 풀폭 시그니처
sections.⑫:
<style>
  .tesla-demo { min-height: 100vh; padding: 24px; color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-base); font-family: Gotham, 'Helvetica Neue', -apple-system, sans-serif; }
  .tesla-demo * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .tesla-demo button { font-family: inherit; }
  .tesla-header { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; }
  .tesla-wordmark { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .6em; }
  .tesla-status { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; }
  .tesla-status strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 600; }
  .tesla-hero { max-width: 1180px; min-height: 480px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(310px, .9fr) minmax(390px, 1.1fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
  .map-panel { position: relative; min-height: 480px; overflow: hidden; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default); background: linear-gradient(32deg, transparent 48%, var(--border-subtle) 49%, var(--border-subtle) 51%, transparent 52%), linear-gradient(148deg, transparent 54%, var(--border-subtle) 55%, var(--border-subtle) 57%, transparent 58%), var(--bg-subtle); }
  .map-panel > svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .map-road-wide { fill: none; stroke: var(--bg-elevated); stroke-width: 30; stroke-linecap: round; }
  .map-route { fill: none; stroke: var(--color-info-fg); stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }
  .route-card { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 20px; left: 20px; right: 20px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 15px; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .turn-arrow { height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--text-on-primary); background: var(--color-info-fg); font-size: 24px; }
  .route-card strong { display: block; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; }
  .route-card small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .route-eta { text-align: right; }
  .route-eta strong { font-size: 13px; }
  .route-eta small { font-size: 11px; }
  .speed { position: absolute; left: 20px; bottom: 22px; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .speed strong { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
  .speed span { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .vehicle-panel { position: relative; min-height: 480px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 58px 34px 28px; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .gear { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 22px; display: flex; gap: 6px; }
  .gear span { min-width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--text-tertiary); border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 11px; }
  .gear .active { color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
  .car-render { width: min(100%, 520px); filter: drop-shadow(0 16px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15)); }
  .car-render .body { fill: var(--text-primary); stroke: var(--border-strong); stroke-width: 2; }
  .car-render .glass { fill: var(--color-neutral-500); opacity: .68; }
  .car-render .detail { fill: none; stroke: var(--bg-base); stroke-width: 2; opacity: .72; }
  .car-render .tire { fill: var(--bg-base); stroke: var(--text-secondary); stroke-width: 7; }
  .vehicle-copy { margin-top: 4px; text-align: center; }
  .vehicle-copy h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .vehicle-copy p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; }
  .quick-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 22px; }
  .tesla-dock { max-width: 1180px; min-height: 64px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px repeat(5, 1fr) 90px; align-items: center; color: var(--text-secondary); background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-top: 0; text-align: center; }
  .tesla-dock button { height: 100%; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 0; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; }
  .tesla-dock button:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-subtle); }
  .tesla-dock strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; }
  .feature-grid { max-width: 1180px; margin: 16px auto 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
  .feature-card { min-height: 154px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--bg-elevated); }
  .feature-card .eyebrow { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .feature-card .value { margin-top: auto; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
  .feature-card .value small { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .feature-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; }
  .charge-track { height: 3px; margin-top: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--border-default); }
  .charge-track span { display: block; width: 72%; height: 100%; background: var(--color-info-fg); }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .tesla-demo { padding: 12px; }
    .tesla-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .map-panel, .vehicle-panel { min-height: 360px; }
    .map-panel { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
    .tesla-dock { grid-template-columns: 70px repeat(3, 1fr) 70px; }
    .tesla-dock button:nth-of-type(n+4) { display: none; }
    .feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
